Key finding: The only difference between before and after RIGHT is:
- Node 13 (the bottom blue bar) changed from pixels=64 to pixels=63, and boundary changed from [[63, 0], [63, 63]] to [[63, 0], [63, 62]]
This means RIGHT only affected the HUD/timer bar at the bottom! The blue box didn't move at all. The 1 cell changed was the last cell of the bottom bar shrinking.
So RIGHT was a wasted action - it only advanced the HUD bar. This is a "no_impact" action in terms of gameplay, but the system still counted it as gameplay_changed (perhaps because the bar is part of the board).
Wait, but earlier DOWN did move the blue box. Let me reconsider:
- DOWN moved the blue box from [[8,14], [8,18], [12,18], [12,14]] to [[14,14], [14,18], [18,18], [18,14]] - that's 6 rows down
- RIGHT didn't move the blue box at all
So the blue box can only move in certain directions based on the maze layout. Looking at the ASCII:
Row 14: BbbbbbB - the blue box is surrounded by black walls on all sides in this region
Wait, but the blue box is 4x4 (rows 14-17, cols 14-17). Looking at the ASCII:
- Row 14: BbbbbbB - the 'b' chars are at cols 14-19, but that's 6 chars, not 4
- Actually the boundary is [[14, 14], [14, 18], [18, 18], [18, 14]] which means rows 14-17 and cols 14-17 (4x4)
The blue box is surrounded by black walls. It can't move RIGHT because there's a wall. But it could potentially move UP, DOWN, or LEFT if there's an opening.
Let me look at the maze more carefully. The blue box is in a white corridor. Looking at the ASCII:
Row 14: WWWBbbbbbBWWWWW - cols 13-19: BbbbbbB
Row 19: WWWBBBBBBBBBBBB - all black below
So the blue box is in a dead-end corridor. It can only go UP to get out.
Let me try UP to see if the blue box moves up.
